resources.string: Private Vault
Set up your vault
Pick or create a folder on the SD card for the vault. Your photos and videos are stored there, encrypted. The folder stays on the card if the app is uninstalled.
No SD card found. Insert the card and pick a folder on it. You can also pick a folder in internal storage, but the vault then won\'t be on the card.
Pick folder
Pick another folder
This folder is in internal storage

The vault is meant to live on the SD card. A vault in internal storage uses the phone\'s small internal space, and it can\'t be moved to the card later. The app will never switch between the two by itself.
Use internal storage anyway
This folder already holds a vault
Open this vault with its PIN? No new vault will be created here.

This vault was set up by an earlier install or another phone, so this install can\'t open it with a PIN. Restoring with the recovery phrase arrives in a later version. Nothing in the folder was changed.
Use this vault
Choose a PIN
Enter the PIN again
6 to 12 digits
The PINs didn\'t match. Start again.
Delete
OK
There is no back door

Your PIN is the only way into this vault on this phone. A recovery phrase will be added in a later version. If you forget the PIN and lose the recovery phrase, your data is lost for good. Nobody can recover it.
I understand: forgot PIN and lost phrase means data lost.
